$description: The colour slot declarations: the groups (their parts, the properties each paints, its options and states, and the rest role of each property where a group part is read), the members (every coloured part of every manifest mapped onto a group part, or null when it paints only current or transparent), and each exception with the decision that grants it. scripts/lib/core/color-slots.ts:readColorSlots(root) derives every slot from them, and check:color-slots holds both.
